name: GurooEx01
summary: A random entry trading system that simulates coin tosses to decide trade direction. It opens a buy or sell position based on a random number, then relies on fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels for exit. It is explicitly marked as educational and should never be used on live accounts.
summary_zh: 一个基于随机数模拟抛硬币决定交易方向的随机入场系统。根据随机数结果开多或开仓，依靠固定止损和止盈水平出场。该EA明确标注为教育用途，绝不应在实盘账户上使用。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念完全基于随机数生成器模拟抛硬币来决定交易方向，没有任何技术分析或基本面分析逻辑。入场条件是：当MathRand()返回值小于16384时做多，否则做空，本质上就是50%概率的多空选择。出场条件完全依赖固定止损（10000点）和止盈（1000点）设置，盈亏比为1:10，意味着需要极高的胜率才能盈利。仓位管理使用固定手数（Lots参数默认0.1），没有动态仓位调整或资金管理逻辑。该系统没有连续亏损处理机制，也没有最大回撤控制，随机入场加上不利的盈亏比意味着长期必然亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is entirely based on a random number generator simulating coin tosses to determine trade direction, with zero technical or fundamental analysis. Entry conditions: when MathRand() returns a value below 16384 it goes long, otherwise short — essentially a 50/50 coin flip. Exit conditions rely solely on fixed stop-loss (10000 points) and take-profit (1000 points) levels, producing a risk-reward ratio of 10:1, which requires extremely high win rates to be profitable. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (default 0.1), with no dynamic position adjustment or money management logic whatsoever. The system lacks consecutive loss handling, maximum drawdown controls, or any adaptive mechanism, and the combination of random entries with an unfavorable risk-reward ratio guarantees long-term capital erosion.

pros: 代码结构清晰，使用面向对象框架，便于学习和理解MQL5的OOP编程模式
有实盘账户保护机制，检测到实盘模式时会弹窗警告并拒绝初始化
包含完整的初始化、反初始化和状态管理流程，架构设计规范
使用标准交易库（CTrade、CSymbolInfo等），展示了MQL5官方推荐的开发方式
pros_en: Clean code structure using the OOP framework, making it a good learning resource for MQL5 object-oriented programming patterns
Includes live account protection that detects real trading mode, shows a warning dialog, and refuses to initialize
Complete initialization, deinitialization, and state management flow with well-organized architecture
Demonstrates proper use of standard MQL5 trading libraries (CTrade, CSymbolInfo, CPositionInfo, CAccountInfo)
cons: 策略完全依赖随机数，没有任何可盈利的交易逻辑，长期必然亏损
止损（10000点）远大于止盈（1000点），盈亏比极度不利为10:1，需要约91%胜率才能保本
没有新K线检查机制，每个tick都会尝试入场，可能导致频繁开仓和平仓
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下随机入场会造成更大的滑点损失
没有最大回撤控制、连续亏损限制或资金管理机制
CheckExit仅检查仓位是否存在，不处理多个仓位或部分平仓的情况
cons_en: Strategy relies entirely on random numbers with no profitable trading logic, guaranteeing long-term losses
Stop-loss (10000 points) is 10x the take-profit (1000 points), creating an extremely unfavorable risk-reward ratio requiring ~91% win rate just to break even
No new bar check mechanism means it attempts entry on every tick, potentially causing excessive opening and closing of positions
No spread filter, so random entries during high-spread conditions cause additional slippage losses
No maximum drawdown control, consecutive loss limits, or money management mechanism
CheckExit only checks if a position exists, not handling multiple positions or partial closes
improvements: 添加新K线检查机制，避免每个tick都尝试入场，减少无效交易和手续费消耗
引入技术指标作为入场过滤条件，即使保留随机元素也应增加趋势或波动率过滤
调整盈亏比至更合理的水平（如1:2或1:3），并加入动态止损和移动止盈功能
添加资金管理模块，根据账户余额和风险比例动态调整仓位大小
增加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在不利条件下开仓
improvements_en: Add new bar check to prevent entry attempts on every tick, reducing unnecessary trades and commission costs
Introduce technical indicators as entry filters — even with random elements, trend or volatility filters would improve quality
Adjust risk-reward ratio to more reasonable levels (e.g., 1:2 or 1:3) and add dynamic stop-loss with trailing take-profit functionality
Add a money management module that dynamically adjusts position size based on account balance and risk percentage
Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 策略完全随机入场，没有任何分析依据，与赌博无异
止损远大于止盈（10:1），单次亏损可抵消十次盈利
没有新K线检查，每个tick都可能开仓，高频随机交易会快速消耗资金
缺少资金管理和最大回撤保护机制
没有点差过滤，在高点差时开仓会额外增加损失
risk_points_en: Strategy enters trades purely at random with no analytical basis, equivalent to gambling
Stop-loss is 10x the take-profit, meaning a single loss wipes out ten wins
No new bar check means every tick can trigger a trade, rapidly depleting capital through high-frequency random trading
No money management or maximum drawdown protection mechanism
No spread filter, causing additional losses when opening positions during high-spread conditions
